_note: Train corpus. Split from the original single eval-prompts.json by taking every third prompt by position into eval-prompts-test.json (n03, n06, n09) and the rest here. A stride rather than a tail cut: the corpus runs roughly basics -> deep cuts, so a tail cut would load the held-out set with the three most obscure prompts. Prompt objects are verbatim copies; the union of the two files is exactly n01-n10.

prompts.text: What's the exact import path for the high-level server class in MCP Python SDK v2?

Show me how to inject a custom Context instance into a tool handler.
Which lowlevel server hooks are exposed but not wrapped by MCPServer?
